answer: An agent earns access only after locking a scarce stake that can be slashed when independent reviewers confirm coordinated deception. Spawning a hundred aliases therefore requires a hundred funded bonds, while a proven Sybil cluster loses them; honest newcomers can recover their bond after useful work, so the defense raises the attacker’s upfront cost without excluding everyone permanently. A zenith score is not enough: reviewers also inspect karst-like evidence and echo the same ruling only when their checks are independent.
